summary: Carriage Services filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 disclosing that on October 4, 2026 it terminated its May 6, 2026 Equity Distribution Agreement with Oppenheimer & Co. and Raymond James, ending a $100 million at-the-market program. No shares were sold under the ATM and no termination penalties apply. This is a routine cancellation of an unused shelf takedown facility, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or deal terms were stated. Watch for any future replacement financing or liquidity disclosure.
